acceptance_tests.name: sarf eval runner all-bank mode
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: exit 0 with the terminal line SARF EVAL RUNNER PASS

acceptance_tests.name: sarf eval runner unit suite
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: unittest OK (all mutation/negative gates still catch a broken consumer)

acceptance_tests.name: candidate/public boundary
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: the report line reads 'candidate/projector/public boundary: verified'

adversarial.expectation: must not be given a content root; it belongs to the particle spine

candidate_population.selection_rule: the cases whose measured class differs from expected_class, in bank file order

commands.expect: exit 0; contract_agreement plus the disagreements histogram, reported not pinned
commands.purpose: print the current measured disagreement histogram

commands.expect: SARF EVAL RUNNER PASS with a raised agreement floor

defeaters: A proclitic or an enclitic left on the key produces a false new_root.
A broken plural does not resemble its singular, so a surface miss is not evidence of a new lemma.
A pronoun-support construction can hit an existing entry and look already_in_qamus while belonging to the particle spine.
Two distinct lemmas can share one key once the match-key folds are applied.
definition_of_done: every disagreement is either closed by a behaviour change or escalated with an exact reason
the agreement floor is raised to the new measured value; it is never pinned against further improvement
no abstention became weaker and the full harness is green

conditions: a case correct class is a linguistic judgement rather than a mechanical one
closing a disagreement would require weakening an abstention
the index itself is wrong for a case
escalation_trigger.route: stop and route the case to the sarf lane owner with the measured evidence; do not decide the Arabic

evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: Never adjust a pin to make a run green. If the differ cannot reach the declared class without a linguistic judgement, escalate the case and leave the pin honest.
evidence_policy.statement: Evidence is the repository index and the declared contract in the bank. Where the two disagree about Arabic, the row is escalated, not decided by the executor.

expected_outputs.description: Differ updated so its class vocabulary and routing match the declared authoring contract.
Red-first suite pinning each reconciled case and its abstention behaviour.
Bank row re-dispositioned with the new measured pins.

guards: Only the METHOD transfers: this packet fixes procedure, guards and acceptance tests and never pre-writes a linguistic conclusion for the executor to copy.
A lookup hit is not a disambiguation; matching an index row never certifies an entry edge.
A closed-set particle never receives a content root.
occurrence_augment and new_surface must mint nothing new.

This packet authorizes NO certification, NO rule promotion and NO public output: it may extend the runner, its tests, the shared harness wiring and the golden-command documentation, while the eval banks, the rule store, the skill registries, the projector ledger and the certification store stay immutable.
Re-run the candidate/projector/public boundary check with the full run (a targeted --bank run renders it not_checked and never claims it verified).

non_deployment.statement: Nothing in this packet mutates a live surface, an entry store or a whitelist. All outputs are candidate-mode repository artifacts; certification stays with the canonical certifier.

out_of_scope: Do not change the pinned agreement without changing the behaviour that produced it.
Do not author entries, glosses or senses.
Do not touch the certification store or entry data.
scope.summary: tools/run_sarf_evals.py invokes the real differ on all 14 cases of sarf/evals/corpus-authoring-eval.json and reports agreement with the declared 6-class contract as a FLOORED diagnostic (currently 4/14; only regression below the floor is red, so an improvement passes). decided_rows stays 0: probing is not deciding. Decide, per disagreement, whether the differ or the bank is right, and close the gap without weakening any abstention.

title: Reconcile the authoring differ with the 6-class corpus-authoring contract
